_purpose: Machine-readable seat topology. Consumed by seat-worktree-gate (write refuse), branch-safety (registered seat branches are live), and generate-combined (state namespaces). Ownership is from recent writes, not from names.

evidence: git log P:/Empressa Trading since 2026-08-15 (TW-68 through TW-74)

_empressaTradingOwnership.why: Observed August writes in empressa-trading are the markets enforcement arc (TW-68 deploy gate, TW-70 sixth state, TW-72 capture halt, TW-73 reading-not-rendering, TW-74 protection-present-is-not-checks-required) cutting through apps/cockpit/backend, tools/deploy_gate, and frontend provenance tiles. A path split is not clean on that evidence. Last-writer-wins is rejected as the ownership rule: it describes who wrote, not who may write next. Product identity (repo_intents: Empressa Cockpit) still names a trading venture. That is why trading remains a registered seat with no exclusive product repo: it requests cockpit changes from markets. Reversal: if trading is seated and writing cockpit product code while markets is still writing spine/gates, declare a path split then (frontend + product routers to trading; spine, capture, deploy_gate to markets) rather than transferring the whole repo.
_empressaTradingOwnership.rejected: path-split by apps/cockpit/frontend vs backend/spine. TW-66 already crossed that boundary in one commit.

integration.name: integration
integration.role: doc_repo primary checkout and merge target. Not a planner seat. Exists so the shared index is a named worktree rather than an unowned default. Planner seats do not do seat work here. The seat-worktree-gate allows this path only on branch main, and refuses writes into another seat's _state namespace from here.

seats.name: property
seats.authority: Property substrate and Empressa property/govtech surfaces: factory and acquisition (legacy-design-tools), hauska-engine, hauska-map, smartcity-dashboards, smart-files. Writes its own _state/property and _inbox/property-* files. May merge its own branches. Does not write smart-markets or empressa-trading. Does not adjudicate another seat's closed finding.

seats.name: markets
seats.authority: Markets substrate: smart-markets (instrument twin) and empressa-trading (cockpit spine, capture, deploy gate). Writes its own _state/markets files. May merge its own branches. Trading seat requests cockpit product/UX changes from this seat. Does not write property-owned repos.

seats.name: trading
seats.authority: Trading product intent and cockpit UX requests. No exclusive product repository until a path split is declared. Writes its own _state/trading files. Requests empressa-trading changes from markets. Does not write product repos.

seats.name: systems
seats.authority: doc_repo hygiene, enforcement controls, seat topology, branch protection settings, C-00 and sibling gates. Shared canon owner for ENFORCEMENT.md and seat_register.json. Read-only scans of product repos. Does not write product repos. May merge its own branch.
